message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend** dates that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a holiday that falls on a weekday (or is observed on a weekday) and therefore gives you at least three consecutive days off (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** |
| 2 | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, PE) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** |
| 3 | Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** |
| 4 | Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20 – May 22** |
| 5 | Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** |
| 6 | Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Friday Nov 11 | – | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** |
| 9 | Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** |
|10 | Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | **Dec 24 – Dec 26** |

### Quick Notes

- **Family Day** is a statutory holiday in several provinces (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island). If your app targets a specific province, you may want to filter accordingly.
- **Canada Day** falls on a Saturday in 2023, so the holiday is observed on Monday, July 3, giving a three‑day break from July 1‑3.
- **Remembrance Day** is a federal holiday on November 11 (Friday), so the long weekend runs from Friday to Sunday.
- **Boxing Day** is a federal holiday on Tuesday, so the long weekend extends from Saturday to Tuesday.

Feel free to plug these dates directly into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays beyond the ones listed, let me know and I can add them.
